description.zh:
个人访问令牌。
使用阿里云AK+SK或使用STS临时授权方式不需要传该字段
description.en: The personal access token. This parameter is not required if you use an AccessKey pair or STS token for authentication.

description.zh: 合并请求局部ID，表示代码库下的第几个合并请求
description.en: The local ID of the merge request. The ID is unique in a repository.

description.zh: 企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
description.en: The organization ID. You can find the ID in the URL when you log on to the Apsara DevOps console. The URL is in the format of `https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{organizationId}`.
The ID or full path of the repository.

title.zh: 查询合并请求版本列表
title.en: Query the list of merge request versions

descriptions.zh: 版本表达的概念类似于一次推送，每个版本会关联一个Commit SHA；一次推送可能会包括多个提交，此时关联的提交ID为推送的最新提交。
descriptions.en: A patch set represents a push and corresponds to a specific commit SHA. If a push includes multiple commits, the patch set uses the commit ID of the latest commit.
